source.caption: The framework of the proposed T-pGNN4DTI model. T-pGNN4DTI primarily comprises a data preprocessing module (for preprocessing drug data and target protein data, respectively), a feature extraction module (for extracting features from drug data and protein data, respectively), a feature fusion module, and an output module.
